text: tree and project structure tool that will list out files according to directories and can add lengths optionally
create a new task with 'todo n hello world' (quotes not necessary because I was too lazy to type quotes when I first wrote todo)
the search command, the one you just used, searches all the tasks for tasks with all the **tags** you add to the query (just 'intro' in our case)
view all pending items with 'todo list' (use 'todo help <cmd>' to learn about flags and args!)
mark a task complete with the task number: 'todo complete 4' (or mark uncompleted with 'todo undo')
attach files to tasks (like shown on 7) with `todo attach` or detach like my ex with `todo detach` (no hate)
now use 'palmtree start <your next task>' to get back to work :) (or use the 'help' commands to learn more)
